svg.text: One kernel class, and one batch's path through it
the class the size ladder's hundred entries emit; every size read off the class
loop method: the group over every full vector of rows, 16 at a time
epilogue: the same group over the rows left at the end, under a mask
the masked driver calls the same groups' masked twins, loopMasked and epilogueMasked, which carry the validity
the class's largest method: 3,856 bytes, measured, under the 8000 the JIT compiles
